title: veronica · homelab
description: Asus NUC, i3-1220P (2 P + 8 E cores), UHD Graphics; always on: Immich, Cortex, telemetry hub

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU model; the value is the thread count.

targets.expr: (((node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host_name="veronica"} * on (host_name, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{host_name="veronica"})) or on (host_name, chip, sensor) label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host_name="veronica"}, "label", "$1", "sensor", "(.*)")) * on (host_name, chip) group_left (chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{host_name="veronica", chip_name=~"k10temp|zenpower|coretemp"}

panels.title: Pressure (time stalled)
panels.description: Share of time some task was stalled waiting on CPU, memory or I/O (Linux PSI).

panels.title: Engines busy
panels.description: Render/3D: graphics and compute (OpenVINO). Video / VideoEnhance: hardware decode, encode and scaling (Immich transcoding and thumbnails). Blitter: copies.

panels.title: Asleep (RC6)
panels.description: Share of time the GPU was powered down. Near 100% when idle.
